tools.name: check
tools.description: Checks the evolve-lang program at path. The text is the langc check --json lines.

tools.name: fmt
tools.description: Gives the canonical text of the evolve-lang program at path, as langc fmt.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Gives the langc report JSON document of the protocol of the evolve-lang program at path.

tools.name: explain-code
tools.description: Gives the row of the diagnostic code in docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md, as langc explain-code.

tools.name: list-steps
tools.description: Gives the 12 protocol steps and their surface forms, as langc list-steps.
